detail.longDescription: Hey DEV! Self teaching C & logic mapping looking to connect with fellow learners! Hello, my name is Nakari. I’m 20 and new to DEV.to! I’m currently self teaching C, exploring pseudocode logic, and super interested in cybersecurity, reverse engineering, and low level programming. I learn best by breaking down systems top down and mapping logic step by step. I’m here to make genuine connections, share learning progress, bounce project ideas around, and solve tricky logic problems together. If you're interested in connecting, talking code, or working on ideas, drop a comment below or reach out! # programming # coding # people # connections # software # development # engineering # inclusive # community Looking for coding friends & connections.
